title: analysis.score_code params and result
description: The deterministic tail of the TEAM ANALYSIS code pipeline as one pure function: code-change health (analyse_changed_files → prioritize_actions → changed_file_summary → coverage_notes, gated by health_enabled), the per-member activity tally over the deduped items, and practice-hygiene scoring (member_practices). Pure by contract: no DB, no network, no clock; Python fetches all tracker state and sends it as params, then overlays provenance and LLM prose on the returned scaffold. Reference implementation: src/yeaboi/analysis/aggregate.py::score_code (build_score_inputs builds the params). Result key order is contractual — these objects feed json.dumps downstream (contract_version, member_activity, practices, health, activity_counts; health's nested order as listed below).

activity_item.description: A normalized activity dict, sent VERBATIM — already annotated with changed_file_paths where the caller's change lookup succeeded (items whose lookup was cap-skipped or failed carry NO annotation, not an empty list; they must stay out of the file-based denominators).

changed_file.description: One change record from the caller's provider fetch: provider, container, repository, path, status, additions, deletions, truncated, error, confidence, url, change_id — sent VERBATIM; unknown keys pass through into file_reports.

changed_file_cache_hits.description: Stamped into repository_health and file_coverage as cached_change_lookups BEFORE coverage_notes reads them — which is why it rides the params.

member_activity.description: One row per selected user (key order: member, commits, prs, ai_marked), sorted by (-(commits+prs), member), plus a trailing 'AI agent accounts' row only when agent-authored activity exists.

practices.description: member_practices' dict verbatim (its internal key order is the contract).

health.description: Empty scaffold ([], {}, [] respectively) when health_enabled is false — never absent.

activity_counts.description: Kind tallies over the deduped items, in exactly this key order.
